questions.hint: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
questions.explain: A habit (обычно, по утрам) → imperfective; only imperfective verbs have a present tense.

questions.prompt: Я ___ эту книгу за два дня.
questions.hint: I read this book (all the way through) in two days.
questions.explain: за + time = how long it took to reach the result → perfective.

questions.hint: Please repeat this word once more. (to your teacher)
questions.explain: One concrete request → perfective imperative: повторите.

questions.hint: I will write to you every day.
questions.explain: A repeated action in the future → imperfective future: буду + infinitive.

questions.prompt: Пока я ___ ужин, я слушал радио.
questions.hint: While I was cooking dinner, I was listening to the radio.
questions.explain: пока (while): two actions going on at the same time → imperfective.

questions.prompt: Мы начали ___ русский язык в школе.
questions.hint: We started learning Russian at school.
questions.explain: начать, кончить, продолжать, перестать + imperfective infinitive.

questions.hint: Don't switch off the light, I'm still reading. (to a friend)
questions.explain: Asking someone not to do something → не + imperfective imperative.

questions.hint: Have you ever seen this film? (just asking whether you have seen it at all)
questions.explain: Asking whether something has ever happened (a plain fact) → imperfective past.

questions.prompt: Пока тебя не было, к тебе ___ Антон.
questions.hint: While you were out, Anton came to see you. (He has left again.)
questions.explain: Came and left again (the result is cancelled) → imperfective; пришёл would mean he is here now.

questions.prompt: Я долго искал ключи, но так и не ___ их.
questions.hint: I looked for the keys for a long time but never found them.
questions.explain: так и не + perfective = the expected result never came; искать is the process, найти the result.

questions.prompt: Вчера мы весь вечер ___ в карты.
questions.hint: Yesterday we played cards all evening.

questions.prompt: Вдруг он ___ и вышел из комнаты.
questions.hint: Suddenly he stood up and left the room.
questions.explain: A sudden single action in a chain of events → perfective.

questions.prompt: Эту дверь нельзя ___: она заперта, а ключа нет.
questions.hint: This door can't be opened: it's locked and there's no key.
questions.explain: нельзя + perfective = it's impossible; нельзя + imperfective = it's not allowed.
One future action with a result → perfective future: позвоню.
A warning against something happening by accident → не + perfective (не забудь).
